description: Re-checks the DNS records for a sending domain now and returns, per record, whether it was found plus expected vs actual values. Updates the saved verification status and can release held signup emails once verified. DNS changes can take minutes to a few hours to show up; if records are missing right after adding them, wait a bit and try again. Explain any wrong record in plain words. Requires API key scope: account.

domain.description: A sending domain or subdomain, for example mail.example.com. No https://, no path.

name: domain_verify
title: Verify sending domain
